annotations.title: Translate or match a trade word between markets

description: Says one building-trade word in US, Canadian, UK and Australian usage, such as plasterboard (drywall in the US) or skirting (baseboard): each market's word, how close each is, false-friend warnings, unit traps such as US and imperial gallons or short and metric tons with their conversions, and the market's document family. Brand names, plurals and misspellings match too.

detail.description: full (the default): the whole answer. summary: the result lines, the citation line and the page only — fewer tokens to read.

from.description: The market whose word it is, where known.

term.description: A trade word or phrase as one market says it, a brand name said for the product, or a misspelling: "plasterboard", "gyprock", "casing", "skirting", "eavestrough", "a yard of concrete".

to.description: The market to say it in.

name: translate_term

documents.description: The family of documents that governs the concept's subject in the named market. No edition, and no claim that it matches another market's document.

for.description: The calculator whose sources, or the document the glossary names for the concept, the subject was read from.

name.description: The glossary's own name that matched.

matchedBy.description: How the word was matched: a glossary name exactly; the same name spaced, hyphenated or plural; a phrase holding a name; a misspelling of one name; or the site's ranking of the definitions.

unitSystems.description: Each named market's primary measurement system, as the site's market registry holds it.

by.description: The engine's unit conversion that gave the result.

definition.description: The defining relation, where one side is not a unit of the conversion table.

citation.description: The one citation line, built from the answer's own data.

lines.description: The result lines, as the report's table gives them.

notes.description: What a professional must decide, when to call one, a false-friend warning, that adoption is local: kept in every summary.

title: Translate or match a trade word between markets
